scope: Recover selection for exact never-activated revoked approvals without workflows; preserve backend enrollment and live authority gates; add closed diagnostics.
riskAnalysis: Read-only local selection may recover only positively proved prepared-then-revoked identities with exact owner/workspace/task/source/enrollment binding and scope hash. No activation, approval reuse, backend policy, spending, credential, timeout or publication change. Unknown lifecycle records fail closed.

threatModel.assets: Immutable prior approvals and workflow evidence, owner/workspace isolation, exact release enrollment and live authority.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Two authenticated unchanged owner GET readbacks validate revoked unused identity before local selection; backend fresh enrollment/approval remains authoritative.
threatModel.abuseCases: Missing workflow used to conceal activated authority; forged scope, stale source, changed readback, injected diagnostic or overwritten saved approval.
threatModel.mitigations: Revoked revision2/lease0, exact prepared-revoked lifecycle, scope digest and enrollment matching; deny unknown events, existing cache overwrite and changed second readback; closed safe error codes.

rollback: Revert only UI repair and contractlock on feature branch; preserve prior configuration and owner records; no revival of revoked grants.

defects.rootCause: Read-only sequence recovery required a workflow for each historical approval, including an unused prepared approval revoked before workflow initialization. Enrollment errors hid safe precondition categories.
defects.detectionGap: Prior recovery fixtures used empty or initialized workflow history; legitimate never-activated revoked approvals were absent.
defects.regression: 165 UI checks including19 new positive and adversarial cases cover exact unused lifecycle, scope hash, activated or malformed denial, cache preservation and sanitized diagnostics.
defects.historicalPrevention: Include prepared-but-never-activated records in lifecycle readback tests; separate local recovery selection from creation of execution authority.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing owner UI and existing backend journal/controller; no additional identity, gateway or authority.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No added packages, credentials or infrastructure.
proactiveReview.threats: Forged revoked record or missing workflow treated as cleanup proof; confidential exception text rendered.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Unknown/active/malformed history denies; interrupted enrollment remains unconfirmed and is read back before replay.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Two-read changes, absent workflows, activation events, scope digest mismatch, foreign owner, queued-plan ambiguity and raw backend errors.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Work QA implementation tests plus separately attributed Auditor adversarial review; no human acceptance claim.
proactiveReview.recovery: Completed24-event prior configuration remains immutable. New exact source must qualify and receive fresh configuration enrollment before inference.
